entities.summary: Jumana Abdu Rahman is an Indian actress, model & social media personality from Dubai, UAE. She works predominantly in Indian and Arab cinema. She has served as a brand ambassador for Dubai Tourism. She has appeared as the lead in over 10 music videos. In 2021, Jumana became the second celebrity, after Shah Rukh Khan, to have her photo displayed on the Burj Khalifa, earning recognition as the UAE's "most popular" internet celebrity.
